suppress.notes:
CVE-2026-78254 (CVSS 7.4) is a path-traversal flaw in APACHE ANT's ftp and scp tasks. It is matched here against JaCoCo's Ant integration jar, org.jacoco.ant:0.8.14, via the CPE cpe:2.3:a:apache:ant:0.8.14 -- a false match on the version number alone: Apache Ant has no 0.8.x release line (it is at 1.x); 0.8.14 is JACOCO's version, and JaCoCo 0.8.14 is the latest release, so there is no upgrade that clears it.
Three independent reasons this is not exploitable here: 1. Wrong product. The artifact is JaCoCo's Ant task integration, not Apache Ant. 2. Build-time only. org.jacoco.ant is code-coverage tooling on the build classpath; it is never a dependency of the application and ships in no artifact. 3. The vulnerable feature is Ant's <ftp>/<scp> tasks fetching from a remote server. This build runs no Ant tasks at all -- coverage is driven by the Gradle jacoco plugin -- so the code path cannot be reached.
Scoped to this artifact AND this CVE: a different CVE on JaCoCo, or this CVE on a real Apache Ant dependency, still fails the build.
Added 2026-09-24 (Step 11 hardening). Re-check when JaCoCo next releases.
